notes: Fixes the Chat YouTube Companion extension connection test. Extension 1.0.2 now explicitly requests permission to reach Chat only at 127.0.0.1 / localhost, which Chrome requires before its background worker can open the local bridge; it cannot reach any LAN or public host. The extension also reports the actual browser or service-worker connection error instead of the unhelpful message ‘unknown’. This release includes chat-youtube-companion-1.0.2.zip and removes the superseded 1.0.1 package. Install the new extension manually from deployment/chrome_extension/chat-youtube-companion-1.0.2.zip, then use the plain ws:// address shown under Settings → YouTube companion extension.
